messages.author: e28329d3e25e358e
messages.subject: Re: output files as "NA"
parts: Hi, this is because the time length of your observed data is different with the time length of the data that you extracted from your simulations (might be more/less days in your observation file). Could you save your project and share the RSWATproject.rds file and observed data with me? I can check to find out exactly why.

messages.subject: Re: output files as "NA"

I am trying to fix this when I have time. In the mean time, you can also try the userReadSwatOutput option (see section 4 https://github.com/tamnva/R-SWAT/wiki/R-SWAT-User-Manual)
